Test.ResultText: -- SetupConfig:{} create view CK.vRes as select ResId = r.ResId, ResName = IsNull( n.ResName, 'Auto.' + cast( r.ResId as varchar) ) from CK.tRes r left outer join CK.tResName n on n.ResId = r.ResId
